name: Chopbelly Maelstrom
description: Chop with the full dead weight of the heavy sabre and let qi thicken the edge at contact.

name: Annealed Knucklebar
description: Plant the heavy blade before the body and let its mass absorb the first blow.

name: Silt Dragcut
description: Advance with a heavy planted step so the weight of the sabre never lags behind the body.

name: Gust Spineback
description: Beat the thick spine against a guard like a hammer to jolt the foe's arms.

name: Annealed Dishguard
description: Roll the heavy blade across an attack and let its mass drive the foe's weapon down.

name: Blazedish
description: Let the mass of the sabre fall in one hew with a surge of qi behind the edge.

name: Hour Slice
description: Bear down on the foe's raised blade with steady qi-fed pressure until its arms give way.

name: Chime Curvespine
description: Smash the foe's blade at the instant it gathers qi and scatter the gathering.

name: Sanguine Whisk
description: Cleave straight through a raised guard with the whole mass of the sabre and a rolling surge of qi.

name: Dishcloak
description: Root the body and hold the heavy blade fixed while qi runs down into the ground against all blows.

name: Rumble Ringpommel
description: Answer an incoming cut at once with a cut along the same line from the other side.

name: Hoarfrost Rearedge
description: Settle into a guard that already holds the answer to the expected cut.

name: Gust Bellyblade
description: Step aside from a cut so the answering stroke can come from the open flank.

name: Blaze Swathe
description: Flick the blade back from a parry into a quick return cut to the wrist.

name: Thorn Brush
description: Slice along the foe's blade after the counter so the two weapons lock in the foe's disfavor.

name: Torrent Tipbend
description: Parry a cut read before it falls and return a cut in the same breath.

name: Wrecking Scrape
description: Slip the blade beneath a descending cut and carry it up into the foe's arm with qi.

name: Lot Brush
description: Chain a parry and a return cut and a second counter in one tightly joined flow of qi.

name: Scorching Rearedge
description: Chop with a halo of qi about the blade that bites a little beyond the steel.

name: Bevelgreave
description: Settle the blade into a guard with the halo spread wide to catch glancing cuts.

name: Gust Tipbend
description: Drift a pace aside with the halo trailing and masking the movement of the blade.

name: Curvespine Assault
description: Skim the halo along the foe while drawing a long slice with the belly.

name: Unyielding Ringpommel
description: Turn the wrist so the halo and the flat together push an attack aside.

name: Might Whisk
description: Hew with the halo packed close along the edge for a cut of greater depth.

name: Iron Scrape
description: Stretch the halo a hand's width past the tip and pierce a guard that seemed out of reach.

name: Unmaking Dishguard
description: Lean the whole halo against a foe's blade so its qi flow is pressed slow.

name: Swathegreave
description: Rap the foe's blade with the halo's edge and ripple its qi out of step.

name: Iron Swathe
description: Cleave at a foe beyond sabre reach with the field of qi carrying the edge across the gap.

name: Granite Knucklebar
description: Sweep the sabre round with the whole field of qi trailing so that every foe near the arc is cut.

name: Sanguine Chopbelly
description: Chop short and downward where there is no room to swing so the blade never touches a neighbor.

name: Unbroken Spineback
description: Press the shoulder into the foe's arm and hold the blade tight across the chest.

name: Silt Bellyblade
description: Edge sideways through a crush of bodies with the blade held upright against the chest.

name: Might Dishguard
description: Slice at arm's length with the belly of the blade drawn across a foe in a tight space.

name: Lambasting Slice
description: Sweep the blade low and wide in one burst to clear a little room around the body.

name: Dominating Flatside
description: Shove with the hilt cap through the crush and break the foe's stance and its flow of qi.

name: Whiskassault
description: Hew along the line of a narrow lane so that foes in file cannot step out of its path.

name: Daybreak Flatside
description: Spin once in the middle of a ring of foes and sweep the edge through all of them at arm's length.

name: Drubbing Slice
description: Cleave through the foe in front even with a wall at one's back using hips and a surge of qi.

name: Might Dragcut
description: Chop and let a trace of qi follow the edge so that the blade tracks the foe's shifts.

name: Thornchop
description: Settle a guard that follows the foe's weapon wherever it moves along its path.

name: Granite Brush
description: Step after the foe in the track of the blade and keep the edge against it.

name: Bellyblade Barrage
description: Draw a slice that tracks the target's motion by the thread of qi laid along the belly.

name: Murkchop
description: Parry with a blade that follows the foe's weapon and rides it aside.

name: Rearedge Torment
description: Hew in a steady rhythm that lets the qi field settle into the foe's tempo.

name: Dishtorment
description: Cut along a thread of qi already laid on the foe's blade to find its carrier's body.

name: Dishbarrage
description: Press the following edge against the foe's blade and ride it down wherever it moves.

name: Fastening Tipbend
description: Draw a loop of qi round the foe's blade with the edge and pull it from line.

name: Scrapehauberk
description: Cut the thread of qi that links the foe's blade to its hand and break the technique.

name: Interlocking Swathe
description: Chain a tracking slice and a snare and a heavy hew as one qi-led sequence on a retreating foe.

name: Raging Glint Chopbelly
description: Follow the foe's qi to the gap in its guard and cleave through the gap in one unbroken stroke.

name: Gustscrape
description: Chop on the first track and leave the blade ready for the paired second track.

name: Facet Flatside
description: Settle a guard in two linked positions that can each answer the same attack.

name: Gust Curvespine
description: Take two matched paces on a single breath so that the feet echo each other.

name: Tempered Spineback
description: Draw two slices along the same line one after the other with qi held between them.

name: Granite Scrape
description: Follow a first cut with a second on the neighboring track before the foe can recover.

name: Torrent Knucklebar
description: Parry on the first track and return on the second with qi carried across between them.

name: Swatheplating
description: Hook the foe's blade twice from either side so the weapon is held between two tracks.

name: Tempered Whisk
description: Bring down two hews in step on the dual tracks so the second lands where the first opened.

name: Intentchop
description: Join a parry and its paired return and a closing cut in one sequence of twinned qi.

name: Unmaking Rearedge
description: Rise on the toes and drop in a stoop with the chop falling like a hawk on prey.

name: Curvespine Cuirass
description: Fold the free arm and the blade across the chest like a hawk's wing at rest.

name: Torrent Ringpommel
description: Glide forward on light feet with the blade held back like a wing drawn behind.

name: Needling Whisk
description: Draw the curved belly across the foe in a raking motion like a talon.

name: Unbroken Tipbend
description: Beat the blade down and out like a wing to throw an incoming cut aside.

name: Blazescrape
description: Leap and hew from above with qi gathered to the edge at the top of the leap.

name: Thorn Ringpommel
description: Rake the curve over the foe's wrist and clamp it with a hooked pull of qi.

name: Sliceassault
description: Circle the foe with a hovering blade and press it in place by threat of the stoop.

name: Cleaving Flatside
description: Gather qi on a high rise and drop in a single cleave that lands with the full weight of the stoop.

name: Granite Dishguard
description: Spring back up and away after the stoop and turn aside any counter with the rising blade.

name: Granite Dragcut
description: Cut in a curve like a river bend so that the edge arrives from beside the foe's guard.

name: Aegis Bellyblade
description: Hold the blade in a bowl-shaped guard that gathers a blow and lets it run off the rim.

name: Silt Slice
description: Cross the foe's line in short even steps like one wading a ford with the blade held high.

name: Might Brush
description: Draw a slice in a small turning eddy that wraps back across the target's flank.

name: Chopplating
description: Turn an attack aside like a current round a stone and slip the foe's qi off its course.

name: Might Spineback
description: Chop with the surge of a river in spate as qi rushes down the arm into the blade.

name: Silt Chopbelly
description: Sweep the sabre in a wide flooding arc that spills qi-edged force over every foe in reach.

name: Chopcloak
description: Take a heavy blow as a river takes a boulder then turn it and return the force with a cut.

name: Severing Dragcut
description: Chop the first of an azure pair of cuts with the blade already turning to the second.

name: Unflinching Knucklebar
description: Guard in a pairing of high and low that covers the body from both a cut and a counter.

name: Whiskpounce
description: Cross one foot behind the other and back again in a matched pair of steps.

name: Raging Rearedge
description: Draw one slice forward and a second back along the same wound with the same qi.

name: Chimedish
description: Turn the wrist twice in a matched pair of parries that wear down a heavy blow.

name: Unmaking Scrape
description: Pair a hew with a second that lands a breath after and a hand's width to the side.

name: Furrowing Dishguard
description: Hew twice with one pulse of qi that splits and rides both cuts together.

name: Raging Chopbelly
description: Press the foe with pairs of cuts that keep it from ever finishing a motion.

name: Whiskhauberk
description: Bind the foe's blade between two crossing edges and hold it there.

name: Rumblebevel
description: Beat twice on the same point of the foe's blade and crack its hold of qi.

name: Scything Whisk
description: Cleave through a guard in two matched strokes whose second carries the first through to the end.

name: Intentscrape
description: Gather qi and release a sequence of paired parries and cuts that closes on the foe's open side.

name: Gust Swathe
description: Chop on a drawn breath as if sworn to the wind with the edge falling clean.

name: Staunch Tipbend
description: Hold the blade slanted like a windbreak so that a cut slides off to the side.

name: Gust Flatside
description: Take quick long paces in the manner of a gale crossing open ground.

name: Sanguine Brush
description: Draw the belly across the foe with a long wind-like pull that thins to the tip.

name: Scrape Maelstrom
description: Hew with an oath's steadiness and drive qi into the edge at the end of the stroke.

name: Murk Ringpommel
description: Turn an attack aside as the wind turns a leaf and unsettle the qi behind it.

name: Slice Torment
description: Press the foe with gusting cuts that never settle into a rhythm it can read.

name: Ironwhisk
description: Gather qi on a held breath and rush in with a hew that falls like a wind from above.

name: Gustbevel
description: Meet a strong cut with a turning parry that spends its force and answers with a gale cut.

name: Severing Spineback
description: Chop along a plain line like a plateau's straight edge without any flourish.

name: Charter Curvespine
description: Hold the blade on the bearing of the foe's weapon and let it come to the guard.

name: Dragcut Pounce
description: Step along the bearing toward the foe without turning aside from the line.

name: Beveltorment
description: Draw a slice that falls away at the end like the sudden drop of an escarpment.

name: Equipoise Ringpommel
description: Turn the wrist to keep the blade on its bearing while an attack is knocked wide.

name: Sanguine Swathe
description: Hew with the shoulders square to the foe as a plateau wind meets a rock.

name: Gust Whisk
description: Cut along a held bearing so that qi in the edge keeps true all the way through.

name: Shadeslice
description: Press the foe back toward an edge of ground with a steady forward press of cuts.

name: Chime Knucklebar
description: Beat the foe's blade off its bearing and scatter its gathering qi.

name: Dishguard Thrash
description: Hold the bearing through every feint and cleave at the last with qi from the whole field.

name: Doctrine Bellyblade
description: Chain a step along the bearing and a press and a cleave in one qi-led sequence.

name: Gustchop
description: Open with a chop spoken as an oath and let qi gather in the edge as it falls.

name: Thorndish
description: Settle into a guard held as a sworn post that does not give ground.

name: Mightslice
description: Step forward only as far as the oath allows and plant firmly.

name: Rumble Flatside
description: Shear the belly across the target with a gale's sideways cutting pull.

name: Gust Brush
description: Hew a heavy stroke that falls like a gale after the oath is spoken.

name: Chimechop
description: Parry an attack from a foe who has broken faith and jar its qi from its line.

name: Splintering Granite Chopbelly
description: Gather qi in the held oath and cleave with all of it in one great downward stroke.

name: Enduring Curvespine
description: Turn the foe's own blow aside with a gale parry and rebuke it with a sharp return cut.

name: Sanguine Spineback
description: Chop from a wide open stance that offers no cover and fears none.

name: Facetchop
description: Settle the blade into a guard that leaves the body open but covers the line of attack.

name: Granite Swathe
description: Step freely across open ground in any direction with the blade trailing low.

name: Tempered Slice
description: Draw a long level slice that follows the skyline from one side of the foe to the other.

name: Murk Bellyblade
description: Parry with the edge turned outward so an attack is thrown into open air.

name: Tempered Rearedge
description: Hew along a level line at the height of the horizon with the hips driving through.

name: Brushassault
description: Hew with a long open stride that uses the whole ground and a pulse of qi in the edge.

name: Lambasting Tipbend
description: Press the foe along the skyline with steady cuts that give it no cover to turn to.

name: Thorn Scrape
description: Hook the foe's blade away from its guard and hold it wide of the body.

name: Chime Ringpommel
description: Beat the foe's blade with a gale-hard stroke that breaks the shape of its qi.

name: Blaze Brush
description: Gather qi in the open stance and cleave across the foe in one long stroke to the horizon.

name: Hour Knucklebar
description: Chain a skyline press and an open bind and a horizon cleave as one qi-led sequence.
